notes.title: Hell of Men: Blood Brothers - New factions!
notes.content:
Hello to all,  

Today, you will discover in this article, the new faction that will be available in v1.  The Baltic Countries are coming in Hell of Men: Blood Brothers! 
The Baltic Countries are represented by 3 skins in the game. Latvia, Lithuania and Estonia. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/4630a5d1170237b4502e4a83035730ca4609eb16.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/340d992c4a52b3284b2fc0e2579599b5b803f9b3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/4e38f8ae854f95e9249f124932b3197cbc044c5a.png[/img]

[u][b]Building:[/b][/u]
The buildings have a "container" style, we find the same as for the other factions except for the infirmary which disappears.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/62bd125ede5892b77a665a2c1cd8d04b0cc42591.png[/img]

The specificity of the tent is its low cost which can give an advantage at the beginning of the game, however it offers only 3 additional population slots. You will have to build more tents than the other factions to reach the maximum of 40 units.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/8a7b2ed6926d01a888698d3305a1481fa6a90e0d.png[/img]

[u][b]Unit:[/b][/u]
[u]Barracks:[/u] 
[list]
[*] Rifleman = Germany/Russia.  
[*] Grenade launcher = all factions.  
[*] Rocket launcher = Poland/Russia.  
[*] Fusion launcher = all factions.  
[*] Operator = Poland/Belarus.  
[*] Machine gunner/Mastodon = + 1 damage / 0.1 rate of fire reduction.  
[*] Sniper/Sniper guillie = - 5 damage / increase rate of fire by +2.  
[/list]

[u]Communication Center:[/u]
[list]
[*] Sapper = Russia - short range.  
[*] Tank crew = Poland/Russia/Belarus.  
[*] Mortar = - 1 damage / increase movement speed by +0.3. 
[/list]

[u]Laboratory:[/u]
[list]
[*] UAV = all factions.  
[*] New Unit : Anti-infantry combat drone.  
[*] New Unit : Anti-tank combat drone.  
[*] New Unit : Healing Drone.  
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/af5cd58a9dc3bf64e5e048ab23f866e6fee12f21.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/019fc0b235d69e476159dc278b8e04fa41cf1b02.png[/img]

The anti-infantry combat drone is inspired by the Estonian Milsem drone with its anti-vehicle variant. It has the same attack stats as the Russian drone with a higher hit point count and reduced speed. Its anti-tank variant joins the French anti-tank drone but uses rockets.  

The healing drone is a flying drone with the ability to heal infantry units.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/16eb4b90e466eb160bdd1b08bcbd9c863b5094f0.png[/img]
 

[u]Vehicle:[/u]  
The Buggy is equal to the other factions with only 3 seats.  
The Jeep is equipped with a grenade launcher and reduced armor –20 health points.  
The Truck is equal to the German faction and unarmed.  
The Armored Support is equal to that of the Polish faction.  
The Light Tank is equal to that of the Polish faction with reinforced armor giving it +50 health points.  
The Tank is equal to the other factions with a reinforced armor giving it +50 health points. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/25cc80b355912943fde0a799a5cd71872f49d713.png[/img]

notes.title: Survive (if you can) the complete adventures of Watracio Walpurgis with this full edition of Baobabs Mausoleum: Country of Woods and Creepy Tales
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33243736/feb608b39adb9d2c178833d1656707d223b60222.jpg[/img]

Zerouno Games and Tesura Games are extremely glad to bring you, AT LONG LAST, Baobabs Mausoleum, the long-awaited full saga, whose new name is Baobabs Mausoleum: Country of Woods and Creepy Tales. 

The adventures of Watracio Walpurgis, our favorite eggplant FBI agent, will be available next Friday February 26th in an exclusive physical version for Nintendo Switch and in digital form (Steam, Switch, PS4, PS5, Xbox One y Xbox Series X|S). You will just have to hippity-hop to your nearest physical store or find it on your favorite digital platform. 

The videogame (‘cause it’s been worth waiting for it) will be available on the platforms of Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation (PS4 y PS5) y Xbox (Xbox One y Xbox Series X/S) *.

[list]
[*] Digital edition: 15,99€  Retail Price 
[*] Normal edition: 30.99€ Retail Price 
[*] Grindshouse edition: 42.99€ Reail Price 
[/list]

*PS5 and Xbox Series X/S versions are compatible with non-optimized PS4 and Xbox One. Optmized versions will be released soon. 


[h1]The Story [/h1]
The town of Flamingo’s Creek is a place that appears every 25 years in Albatross Road, a neighborhood that only becomes a reality in nightmares. 

Meet paranoid characters, break your brain solving puzzles in the most surrealistic situations, feat the Wendigo, the Ovnifagos, leaser chickens and discover hundreds of secrets... 

[b]Welcome to Flamingo’s Creek. [/b]

[b]Population: 64[/b]
 

[h1]Features [/h1]
[list]
[*] Have you ever played as an Eggplant? This is your opportunity! An FBI Eggplant Agent? 
[*] Strange and paranoid blowing nightmare game 
[*] Mixes 2D and 3D gameplay 
[*] Inspired by David Lynch, Twin Peaks, The Legend of Zelda, Day of the Tentacle and more... 
[*] Meet the love of your life and risk it all for her 
[*] The three Baobabs Mausoleum chapters in one epic game... together. 
[/list]

notes.title: Coffee Crisis reaches European territoy with Zerouno Games
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33243736/827cc65d787341f2712f331c6f037fe47c6d01c2.jpg[/img]

[b]Coffee Crisis[/b]

This brawler’s bastard son is already here in non-North American territory. USA, to be clearer.

It also comes under the seal of Zerouno Games to the platforms of Steam, Xbox one and, soon, to PS4.


[b]Does history matter?[/b]

Face hordes of invading aliens and make them go back home with fewer teeth avoiding them, (this "mis-landed”) to steal from us the most appreciated things of our current existence: Wi-Fi, Metal music and COFFEE.
Is there somebody on Earth who wouldn’t love to smash a greedy alien face while listening to Heavy Metal?

The Smurglian race has come to Earth and they’re not leaving until they steal our four most prized commodities: metal music, the best coffee, cat videos, and all the WiFi. Challenge them through unique and innovative levels inspired by real-life areas in Pittsburgh, PA. Join Black Forge Coffeehouse baristas Nick and Ashley, two galaxy gladiators called to arms to stop this madness and remove the Smurglian threat from Earth.


[b]Description[/b]

Coffee Crisis is an arcade-style beat 'em up full of caffeinated carnage! Coffee Crisis is a 16-bit game fullcaffeinated butchers with and extra of bad milk (mood).

•	Single player and local co-op campaign
•	7 caffeinated power-ups to keep your alien-bashing blasting on all cylinders
•	8 challenging bosses
•	Visit real Pittsburgh locations and areas!
•	Charge-up attacks, suplex throws, and high-test weapons!
•	12 professional metal tracks

Crush alien overlords with metal-fueled, caffeine aided combos to save Earth’s most precious resources - free wifi, heavy metal, and coffee! Feel their extra-terrestrial flesh rip to shreds as you crank the alien cries to 11!

notes.title: Baobabs Mausoleum Ep.2: NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Oh, Hi! How is it going?

Well, it is finally here. Watracio has woken up the next morning and has been accused of the disappearance of Daphne, the "friendly" waitress of Flamingo's Creek that he met in the first chapter "Ovnifagos Don’t Eat Flamingos". And he, as he has been the last one with whom he has been seen…then you will have to withstand the blow.

Live Flamingo's Creek in all its extension. Travel its streets and know its characters the madness of the most hated town for our protagonist, Watracio Walpurgis, our FBI eggplant agent…also a vampire.

Enjoy this second and totally immersive adventure in which you will have to follow the track of Daphne Trujillo, find her before it is too late and discover who the hell is the "inhabitant number 64".

http://store.steampowered.com/app/687720/Baobabs_Mausoleum_Ep2_1313_Barnabas_Dead_End_Drive/

Discord is a modern voice & text chat app. Crystal clear voice, multiple server and channel support, mobile apps, and more.

Now, Baobabs Mausoleum is in Discord, so please, don't hesitate to speak with us, and give us your feedback on our channel.

More info about our discord channel: https://discord.gg/wyHMpS

The game is comming soon!!! Save the date: 22th of february 2018.

notes.title: Baobabs Mausoleum Ep.2: 1313 Barnabas Dead End Drive will arrive on February 2018
notes.content:
“Baobabs Mausoleum Ep2: 1313 Barnabas Dead End Drive”, game developed by Celery Emblem and published by Zerouno Games, will arrive this February the 22th 2018.

The previous chapter ended with the kidnapping of Watracio Walpurgis’ girlfriend… and the second chapter starts with him the next morning.

Continuing with the mixing of perspectives: David Lynch, Twin Peaks, The Zelda Saga, we will find the next chapter of evolution with an “open town”. Now you will experience a whole new level of immersion in Flamingo’s Creek’s inhabitants with a main story and secondary missions.

Enjoy this teaser “Baobabs Mausoleum Ep.2: 1313 Barnabas Dead End Drive”. Short but intense.

https://youtu.be/lsUIpF2qmUI

http://store.steampowered.com/app/646600

http://store.steampowered.com/app/687720
